text: 今年10月以来，市场震荡调整，基金投顾逆势加仓A股。据券商统计，A股资产是10月基金投顾组合加仓最多的资产，且这种低位布局的倾向11月以来还在延续。记者获悉，在10月以来的市场波动中，资金逆势流入部分基金投顾机构的组合。
text_en: Since October this year, amid market volatility and adjustment, fund investment advisory portfolios have increased A-share holdings against the trend. According to brokerage statistics, A-share assets were the most added asset class in fund advisory portfolios in October, and this inclination toward low-level positioning has continued into November. Reporters learned that amid the market fluctuations since October, capital has flowed into the portfolios of some fund advisory institutions against the trend.
